evidence_boundary: Both sides and effective precombat combat fields come from a factual CURRENT VCR oracle; only observed seed and combat mass are excluded before conditional ensemble evaluation. Uniform start seeds and the independent 60% anti-carrier Bernoulli branch are scenario assumptions, not empirically calibrated Host RNG. This expansion measures supported cases and mass candidate-set coverage across independently identified games; it does not independently generate entire combat inputs or validate scenario probabilities against held-out terminal results. Special games, extended combat RNG, unknown effective fields fail closed.

ensemble.evidence_boundary: The encounter's sides, identity, effective weapons, ammunition, shields, crew, race, modifiers and combat RNG setting MUST already be known. This module generates ONLY possible seeds and documented combat masses; other mass modifiers are explicitly assumed absent. Seed uniformity and independence of the +360 Bernoulli event are scenario weights, NOT observed Host RNG probabilities. Not an independent NuHost input generator; never use a future VCR as a causal input.
